proposed_pia_title: Marketplace, Provider Network, and Community Product Implementation Atlas
proposed_domain_boundary: Provider profiles, credential verification, listings, discovery, rankings, reviews, referrals, bookings, community moderation, disputes, marketplace payment responsibility, suspension, and delisting.
proposed_owning_truth: Marketplace provider/community domain truth, distinct from facility, relationship, financial, and communication projections.
proposed_personas: Service Provider; Owner; Trainer; Facility Owner; Barn Manager; Community Member; Platform Admin
proposed_entities: ProviderProfile; Credential; Listing; Review; Referral; Booking; ModerationAction; MarketplaceDispute; Suspension
proposed_lifecycle: Draft provider profile -> verification -> listed -> booked/reviewed -> disputed/moderated -> suspended/delisted/archived.
proposed_cross_domain_dependencies: Identity, Relationship/Permission, Financial Truth, Communications, Search/Ranking, Vendor Security, Audit, Records/Retention.
reason_existing_pia_cannot_adequately_ow: No current ten-item PIA owns a two-sided provider/community marketplace truth without distorting Owner Portal, Facility, Relationship, or Financial boundaries.
reason_supplement_is_insufficient: A supplement would spread marketplace truth across multiple existing PIAs and leave credentials, listings, bookings, moderation, reviews, and suspensions without a single owner.
risks_of_not_creating_it: Provider credential, ranking, review, booking, payment responsibility, and moderation decisions may be governed inconsistently or inferred from unrelated domains.
overlap_risks: Must not override PIA-03 permission, PIA-09 financial truth, PIA-10 communication/media rules, or service-provider role identity.
founder_questions: Whether an eleventh PIA may be drafted despite the current ten-item denominator; whether marketplace scope is foreseeable product scope or formally deferred.
